notes: Single ONNX owns direction selection, original float32 phase, six observation frames, virtual servo and start/stop/settle envelope.
12 physical joint-position offsets plus persistent controller state; state actuators have zero transmission, gain and forces.
One direction at a time; retained original motor effort and geometric/contact installation.
Five website frames preserve past ONNX-created observation frames; compact feedback is 99 controller fields + 47 latest observer-frame values + 1 activation epoch.
